title: Classic Joop
body:
"A portal from above sent this mysterious joop down to this store. So powerful, yet so.. weird..."

Description

The Classic joop is a Vehicle that can be purchased in the Classic shop for $86,000.

The Classic Joop was added in the 15m update. It has 4 seats with a top speed of 100 studs/s. This vehicle has a small place for items at the back.

Trivia

  • The part of the name "Joop" is reference to the real life car brand Jeep.
  • Classic Joop is the most expensive vehicle ingame.
  • It has the inscription "Oaklands" on the back.
  • You can actually drift with the Classic Joop if you use a Gravity Coil/Fusion Coil. (Patched Out)

SPEEEEEEEEN
